title: This AI Tool Writes Better Code Than Senior Developers
angle: A senior dev watches AI rewrite their own production code in real-time — and admits it's better. Not a promo. A reckoning.

scenes.voiceover: I gave an AI my best code. It rewrote it. And I couldn't argue with a single line.
scenes.visual_description: Senior dev staring at screen, jaw slightly dropped. Screen reflection visible in glasses. Hard cut zoom on face.
scenes.caption_overlay: MY OWN CODE... ROASTED BY AI

scenes.voiceover: This isn't ChatGPT. This tool was trained specifically on production-grade codebases. Watch what it does.
scenes.visual_description: Screen recording: paste in messy 40-line function. Tool UI loads. Cursor blinks. Tension holds for 1 second.

scenes.voiceover: It cut 40 lines to 11. Eliminated three edge-case bugs I didn't even know existed. Faster. Cleaner. Documented.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: original bloated code left, AI output right. Red highlights on removed lines. Green on optimized logic. Fast scroll.

scenes.voiceover: I sent it to two senior engineers. Neither could find a flaw. One asked if I wrote it myself. I said no.
scenes.visual_description: Cut between two reaction clips: engineer one leans in, engineer two shakes head slowly in disbelief. Text message screenshot flashes.

scenes.voiceover: This isn't replacing devs yet. But if you're not using this, someone else is. And they're shipping faster than you.
scenes.visual_description: Bold white text slams onto black background word by word. Each phrase cuts hard. Final word FASTER pulses red.
scenes.caption_overlay: They're already using it. Are you?

scenes.voiceover: I gave an AI my best code. It rewrote it. And honestly? I'm not going back.
scenes.visual_description: Same opening shot of dev at screen — but now he smirks, nods slowly. Loops perfectly back to scene one for rewatch.
scenes.caption_overlay: The game changed. Did you miss it?

hook_test.format_reference: Wait, what? — Hook with surprising claim → proof → bigger reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: Corridor Crew's 'VFX Artists React' format and Theo Von-style confessional hooks using this exact structure have driven 10M-40M views. The 'I tried X and couldn't argue with the result' personal-stake confession is a proven scroll-stopper in tech commentary content.
hook_test.why_it_works: It weaponizes credibility threat. Developers are a proud tribe. Watching a senior dev admit AI beat them triggers identity-level curiosity. The viewer must see how. Completion rate spikes because the payoff is personal — every dev watching wonders if it would beat THEIR code.
